Stop Genocide: A Film by Zahir Raihan
2014-12-09T00:00:54+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/stop-genocide-a-film-by-zahir-raihan-54510

This documentary, directed by Zahir Raihan -- a pioneer filmmaker of Bangladesh, tells the story of the genocide by Pakistani army in the 1971 Liberation War. it was shared on YouTube in the channel named Amirul Ahsan (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hauRsDJDm4Q).
